Name: Mixed Seed Kiln
Author: socialcoder
Description:
Convert 30 stone, 30 fiber, 30 wood, or 30 sap into Mixed Seeds. The Mixed Seed Kiln requires 100 stone, 100 wood, and 5 charcoal to build and is immediately available for crafting.

This mod is great for people who want to attempt "no store" or "no seed purchase" play-throughs as if they were living off the land as a fully self-sufficient farmer. Feel free to offer suggestions if you enjoy the mod and would like to see me build upon the concept.

I would highly recommend installing the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better Mixed Seeds[/url] mod alongside this which allows Mixed Seeds to also use crops added via other mods (must be JSON Asset-based mods).

I also created a mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13944]Fine I Will Go Make My Own Seeds[/url] which greatly inflates seed prices and increases the rarity of ingredients to make the Seed Maker. It was intended to be combined with this and my other processor mods to overhaul the core gameplay loop and force players to get seeds via other means than stores.
